Requirement: Draft has no official number
Official numbering is atomic and unique on approval
Repeated approval with same idempotency key has one result
Sender receiver and at least one item are required before approval
Operational parties do not require accounting accounts
Item financial values inherit waybill currency in current scope
Negative quantity or amount is forbidden except explicit reversal
Financial status is derived from accepted net collections
Every accepted collection records payer method amount time collector and location
Prohibited item blocks restricted progression according to policy
Permit-required item cannot pass restricted stage without valid permit
Customs-required item creates trackable customs requirement
Release net quantity cannot exceed original remaining quantity
Allocation cannot exceed released remaining quantity
Loaded quantity cannot exceed allocation remaining
One item may be split across multiple trips
Waybill supports partial load arrival and delivery states
Accepted movement event is append-only
Movement correction uses reversal or correction event not update or delete
Partial arrival never marks full waybill arrival
Driver and vehicle accruals derive from actual trip or manifest execution
Commission uses one trigger and rule snapshot to prevent duplication
Redispatch across trips does not create new waybill transport revenue
Operational delivery does not imply financial close
Financial close requires zero remaining and closed accountabilities and settlements
Financial reopen requires privileged permission reason and audit
Post-approval financial changes require authority and before after reason audit
POD and partial delivery bind to actual items and quantities
Delivery quantity cannot exceed local available balance
Driver or agent collection remains accountability until remittance and settlement
Offline may create drafts or authorized queued events but not publish official numbering
Sensitive retryable operations carry stable client operation identity
Attachments keep storage reference hash uploader and audit metadata
Active hold blocks configured actions by hold type
Redirect retains previous route and appends new route history
Loss damage and shortage are recorded as exceptions with evidence and quantity
Discount cannot exceed caller authority
Exchange-rate change after approval requires controlled authority and correction
Reports derive from movement and collection ledgers not unexplained summaries
Movement and financial reports support drilldown to source record
